rheaRematch.title: Champion's Field Test
rheaRematch.battleIntro: No field notes today, Champion. Just our strongest teams.
rheaRematch.repeatDialogue: The League can call you Champion. Out here, you are still my favorite rival.

introDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
introDialogue.text: You calmed the Beacon and conquered the League. Somehow, standing still still does not suit either of us.

introDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
introDialogue.text: My final field team is ready. Champion, show me what your journey taught you.

winDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
winDialogue.text: That was the answer I wanted. Titles changed around us, but the road between rivals did not.

lossDialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
lossDialogue.text: A Champion can lose a battle and still choose the next step. Come back when you want another.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Lumen
dialogue.text: Champion, the League record is complete, but the region has not run out of questions.

dialogue.speaker: Archivist Mira
dialogue.text: A quiet lunar signal has appeared over the Lake. It does not match the Beacon's old pattern.

dialogue.speaker: Ranger Sol
dialogue.text: The habitats are stable. Revisit a few routes and help us confirm the calm will hold.

dialogue.speaker: Rhea Vale
dialogue.text: And when the research is done, find me on the Mountain. I owe the Champion a real rematch.

dialogue.speaker: Archivist Mira
dialogue.text: The Lake's signal is gentle, almost dreamlike. It is an invitation, not another crisis.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Lumen
dialogue.text: Approach carefully. Whatever appears must be free to battle, flee, or be caught normally.
